_: C組 #2 — package target/location → quest alias. A radiant quest fills aliases (a VIP actor + a dungeon location); its performance packages then ACT on those aliases: travel to the dungeon the alias picked, escort the VIP there. Syntax: 'alias:<name>' (the ref/actor the alias holds → PackageTargetAlias / LocationFallback AliasForReference) or 'aliasLoc:<name>' (the location a location-alias holds → LocationFallback AliasForLocation). ownerQuest MUST be in-spec so alias indices resolve. ⚠ Mutagen field shape is reflection-verified, but whether AliasForReference vs AliasForLocation / PackageTargetAlias byte-matches a real radiant package needs a main-machine xEdit compare (see WAIT_USER). FormIDs verified vs Skyrim.esm: VIP forced fill = Thoring(Npc) 0x013621 (the Windpeak Inn bartender in Dawnstar — leaving his inn to walk off is an obvious in-game tell); Safehouse findMatchingLocation LocType keyword = LocTypeDungeon(Keyword) 0x0130DB; package templates = Travel(PackageTemplate) 0x016FAA + Escort(PackageTemplate) 0x023B73 (both confirmed correct, unchanged).

aliases.name: VIP
aliases._: alias index 0 — forced to Thoring (Windpeak Inn bartender, Dawnstar; Npc 0x013621). The `packages` list is the ALPS alias-override that actually DRIVES him: while this alias is filled he runs MFTravelToSafehouse (highest priority first), so he leaves the inn and walks to the runtime-picked Safehouse location. WITHOUT this list the PACK record exists but never runs — the package's PackageTargetAlias/LocationFallback alone do nothing.

aliases.name: Hold
aliases._: alias index 1 — broad findMatchingLocation anchor (LocTypeHold 0x016771). A 'Find Matching Location' alias is resolved relative to the player's current location hierarchy; the player is ALWAYS inside some Hold so this fills, giving Safehouse a parent to search within. WITHOUT this anchor a bare Dungeon findMatchingLocation fails at StartGameEnabled time (player isn't in a dungeon) → required-alias failure cascades and clears ALL aliases incl. the forced VIP (root cause of the 2026-06-21 'running but both empty' in-game result). Mirrors the IN-GAME CONFIRMED radiant_alias Hold→Dungeon@Hold chain.

aliases.name: Safehouse
aliases._: alias index 2 — a Dungeon-type location (LocTypeDungeon 0x0130DB) picked at runtime WITHIN the Hold alias (@Hold), so it has a search anchor and actually fills.

packages._: Travel to the LOCATION the Safehouse alias holds (aliasLoc: → AliasForLocation).
Escort the VIP actor (alias: target) to the Safehouse location (aliasLoc: destination).
